cause_quote: The original implementation passed the raw `/api/v1/whoami` handle from `const publisher = result.user?.handle` into the lowercase-only check `!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$/.test(publisher)`, which rejected any uppercase letter.
user_saw: Creators with mixed-case ClawHub handles saw “Your ClawHub account needs a personal publisher handle” when trying to review or publish a template in the Control UI.
summary: The fix trims and lowercases the ClawHub account handle before validating it and using it for template review and publication.
reasoning: The introducing diff added both draft review and publish handlers, and both called `personalPublisher` with the lowercase-only validation already in place. I checked the blamed refactor and followed the file through the Template rename and inline review changes, which carried forward the same validation.
